IC1: - Male [OR] or female, 18 to 65 years of age.
IC3: - Present to Stanford Emergency Department as a trauma [AND] with a major operative lower extremity injury
IC4: - Glasgow coma scale of 15 within 24 hours after admission [OR] or extubation
IC5: - Negative urinary toxicology screen for illicit substances;
IC6: - Negative pregnancy test if female [AND] and less then 60 y/o;
IC7: - [NOT] No suspicion for a head injury [OR] and/or negative head CT scan for intracranial hemorrhage [OR] or injury based on standard of care
IC8: - [NOT] No history of seizure disorder [OR] or other neurological disorders.
IC9: - All patients included must screen positive for PHQ-9 score >4 (positive symptoms of depression) [AND] and CES-T score <36 (poor coping self-efficacy).
